summary: A well-presented three-bedroom end-of-terrace property, offered for sale with a tenant in situ and currently achieving a rental income of £750 per calendar month, making this an attractive opportunity for investors seeking an established rental property.
description:
The accommodation briefly comprises an entrance hall, lounge, separate dining room and kitchen to the ground floor. To the first floor, there are three bedrooms and a family bathroom. Externally, the property benefits from an open outlook over green space to the front, whilst to the rear there is a fence-enclosed, paved garden providing a low-maintenance outdoor area, together with useful brick-built storage and gated access. Situated in the popular village of Burnopfield, the property is conveniently placed for local amenities, everyday shopping facilities and nearby schools. The village offers a community atmosphere, with surrounding countryside and green spaces providing opportunities for outdoor recreation. Local shops, convenience stores and public transport links are available within the wider village area, whilst nearby towns provide access to a broader range of shopping, leisure and employment facilities. An excellent opportunity for landlords looking to acquire a three-bedroom property with an existing tenant and an established rental income.

ENTRANCE HALL The entrance hall is accessed via a UPVC-framed double-glazed entrance door, with an adjacent window allowing natural light to flow into the space. There is a radiator, staircase leading to the first floor and a door providing access into the lounge.

LOUNGE The spacious lounge enjoys a pleasant outlook over the green space to the front aspect via a UPVC-framed double-glazed window. The room features an attractive fireplace surround with inset and hearth, a radiator and a door providing access to the kitchen.

KITCHEN The kitchen is fitted with a range of wall and base units, complemented by laminate work surfaces and tiled splashbacks to the work areas. There is an inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap, an integrated oven, hob with extractor hood over, plumbing for an automatic washing machine and space for a tall fridge freezer. Further features include a radiator, a UPVC-framed double-glazed window and a UPVC-framed double-glazed door providing access to the rear garden. A further door leads through to the dining room.

DINING ROOM The dining room features a UPVC-framed double-glazed window allowing natural light into the room, together with a radiator. There is ample space to accommodate a dining table and chairs, creating a practical area for family meals and entertaining.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING The first-floor landing provides access to all three bedrooms and the family bathroom, together with a loft access hatch.

BEDROOM ONE A spacious double bedroom featuring a UPVC-framed double-glazed window providing natural light, a radiator and built-in wardrobes/storage offering useful clothes and storage space.

BEDROOM TWO Bedroom two features a UPVC-framed double-glazed window allowing natural light into the room, a radiator and a built-in storage cupboard incorporating hanging space, providing useful additional storage.

BEDROOM THREE Bedroom three benefits from a UPVC-framed double-glazed window allowing natural light into the room, together with a radiator and space for bedroom furniture.

FAMILY BATHROOM The family bathroom is fitted with a white suite comprising a panelled bath with mains-fed shower over, wash hand basin and WC. The room further benefits from tiling to the splashback and vanity areas, a radiator and a UPVC-framed double-glazed window providing natural light and ventilation.

EXTERNALLY

To the front, the property benefits from a lawned garden area, enjoying a pleasant outlook over the adjoining green space with established trees, creating an attractive setting. To the rear, there is a fence-enclosed, paved garden providing a low-maintenance outdoor space, together with gated access and useful brick-built storage.
